_note: v2.7 plan 39 (NOT YET RUN; row S-16, the v2.7 36 quest lifecycle): hidden -> offered -> active -> done with the reward landing once; an offer the party never accepts stays 'offered' (no close, no reward) even when its done gate holds; completion toggling (paid true, false, true) leaves the debt closed 'done' and its reward landed once; a quest done and failed in the same boundary (one mocked read carrying both DELTAs) closes 'failed' with no reward; a story update after the reward that changes the reward hot-swaps as compatible and re-applies nothing; a same-chat reopen equals the continuous run. No model call: author writes are /cp set boundaries, the one read is a debugResponse. Versions are asserted relative to each other, because the library keeps the record across runs and a re-import of v1 content after a v2 bumps the version. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-36-quest-lifecycle.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

[]).map((quest) => [quest.id, quest.status])); const check = (want, extra) => { const got = statuses(); const v = values(); for (const [id, status] of Object.entries(want)) if (got[id] !== status) throw new Error('quest ' + id + ': expected ' + status + ', got ' + got[id] + ' (all ' + JSON.stringify(got) + ')'); for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(extra ?? {})) if (v[key] !== value) throw new Error(key + ': expected ' + JSON.stringify(value) + ', got ' + JSON.stringify(v[key])); return { statuses: got, coins: v.coins }; }; globalThis.__s16 = { values, statuses, check }; return check({ cat: 'hidden', debt: 'hidden', map: 'hidden' });

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const s16 = globalThis.__s16; const before = rt.getSnapshot().storyIdentity; const beforeHash = rt.getSnapshot().storyHash; const raw = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(rt.getPlayedStoryRaw())); const debt = raw.quests.find((quest) => quest.id === 'debt'); debt.reward = { set: { coins: { add: 9 } }, label: 'Free passage and a drink' }; const imported = await rt.importStory(JSON.stringify(raw)); if (!imported) throw new Error('the updated story did not import: ' + JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().validationErrors)); const outcome = await rt.applyStoryUpdate(); if (!outcome.applied || outcome.classification !== 'compatible') throw new Error('a changed earned reward must hot-swap as compatible: ' + JSON.stringify(outcome)); const after = rt.getSnapshot().storyIdentity; const afterHash = rt.getSnapshot().storyHash; if (!afterHash || afterHash === beforeHash) throw new Error('the update did not change the story this chat plays: ' + JSON.stringify({ beforeHash, afterHash, outcome })); if (after?.drifted !== false) throw new Error('the chat does not play the library copy after the update: ' + JSON.stringify({ before, after })); return { outcome: { from: beforeHash, to: afterHash, classification: outcome.classification }, state: s16.check({ debt: 'done', map: 'failed', cat: 'offered' }, { quest_debt_rewarded: true, coins: 3 }) };
